intro: Your comfort is personal—and our Aqmatic Pocket mattress understands that. With body-responsive springs and a quilted top, it cradles you in softness while supporting every curve.

features.title: Springs that adapt to you for better sleep
features.text: Enjoy personalised support with individually wrapped springs that adapt to your body—minimising motion transfer for peaceful, uninterrupted sleep.

features.title: Enjoy pressure-free comfort every night
features.text: Sleep deeper and wake up revitalised—this mattress evenly distributes weight, reducing pressure points for unmatched relaxation and comfort.

features.title: Quilted fabric top for everyday comfort
features.text: Sleep better with a breathable, soft surface that adds an extra layer of comfort, making your nights more restful and rejuvenating.

features.title: Stay undisturbed with body-hugging support
features.text: Our adaptive foam responds to how you sleep, gently adjusting to your position to provide tailored comfort and deeper, more restful sleep.

features.title: Elegant side trim made of upholstery fabric
features.text: The side trim crafted with premium upholstery fabric adds a touch of elegance and durability. This design detail enhances the mattress’s aesthetic appeal while ensuring lasting strength and a refined finish.

features.title: Sized just right for your bed frame
features.text: No more mismatches—our design adapts seamlessly to any bed size, ensuring both comfort and harmony.

name: Aqmatic Pocket Double Bed Spring Mattress 78 X 48 X 6 Inches
